title: Dublin block-fill recede also scales alpha, contradicting the documented 'rides the RGB mix, not the alpha twin' mechanism — GPU renders a compounded recede the verified goldens never see
evidence: comment: "The recede rides the RGB MIX like the frontage edge below — the alpha twin alone was INERT under rlsw" / spec r1 fold: "the fill recede rides the RGB mix (crisis_recede), not the alpha twin" — code: "col := crisis_recede(v, recede, fam)\n\tcol.a = u8(f32(fam.a) * crisis_recede_scale(recede))"
detail: rlsw renders DrawTriangle opaque, so goldens/palcheck verify the RGB mix only; on the GPU app the alpha scale compounds (family 204→71), receding played-renderer blocks far harder than the blessed canon. Code and docs disagree.
recommended_fix: Drop the alpha line (col.a = fam.a) to match the documented mechanism, or amend spec/PR-body to state the twin applies on GPU deliberately.
